comments.comment: Much of eugenic thinking and practices are becoming more acceptable again, largely through rephrasing, new technologies, and emphasis on individual choice rather than state coercion. Instead, it’s a shift toward “liberal eugenics” or “new eugenics” framed as parental autonomy, health optimization, and reducing suffering.
